findings.session_summary: Initial Family Liaison session focused on identifying barriers to communication (late notices, missed meetings) and planning a small step to map contact channels.
findings.primary_concern: Uncertainty about school communication formats and difficulty understanding/noticing notices.

tracked_details.detail: Agreed between-session task: Ask guardian which contact time works best.
Activity: Mapping school communication channels tried.

findings.conclusion: The session established a plan to map communication channels. The main barrier (uncertainty about contact methods) remains unresolved as the student prefers small, adjustable steps. No external support was delivered; only mentoring activities occurred.

findings.session_summary: Follow-up session reviewed the previous plan. The agreed task regarding the guardian was not confirmed as completed.
findings.primary_concern: The difficulty persists on some days; uncertainty remains about whether external support is available or delivered.

tracked_details.detail: Agreed between-session task: Ask guardian which contact time works best.
Activity: Rehearsing a short explanation of the student's school need.

next_steps: Try one manageable thing and record what happened
uncertainties: Whether the guardian contact was made
findings.conclusion: The student reported uncertainty about completing the previous task. The main barrier (uncertainty and difficulty planning) remains unresolved. No external support was delivered; only in-session rehearsal occurred.

findings.session_summary: Third follow-up session. The student explicitly stated they could not complete the agreed step due to home/school timing difficulties.
findings.primary_concern: Uneven progress; difficulty persists on some days. Uncertainty about service availability remains.

tracked_details.detail: Agreed between-session task: Ask liaison office to confirm contact or try a smaller school-based step.
Activity: Preparing a contact request for appropriate staff member.

next_steps: Ask liaison office to confirm contact status
findings.conclusion: The student explicitly reported failure to complete the agreed step. The main barrier (uncertainty and practical difficulty) remains unresolved. No external support was delivered; only mentoring activities occurred. Evidence supports that the intervention has not yet resulted in improved attendance or resolved the primary communication barrier.
